sub-flow.name: upgrade-sap-config-subflow
sub-flow.doc:name: Upgrade SAP Config Sub-Flow
sub-flow.doc:description: Fetches global.xml and upgrades SAP connection from Application Server to Message Server format with Extended Properties and inline message-server config

set-variable.doc:name: Init gxFound=false
set-variable.doc:description: Default: global.xml not found; overridden to true if file exists in repo

try.doc:name: Try Fetch global.xml
try.doc:description: Attempts to fetch global.xml; continues with gxFound=false if file is absent

http:request.doc:name: GET global.xml from feature branch
http:request.doc:description: Retrieves the base64-encoded global.xml from the feature branch

set-variable.doc:name: Store global.xml SHA
set-variable.doc:description: Stores blob SHA required for GitHub PUT commit

set-variable.doc:name: Set gxFound=true
set-variable.doc:description: Marks that global.xml was found and is ready for upgrade

on-error-continue.doc:name: global.xml not found - skip
on-error-continue.doc:description: Continues when global.xml is absent from the target repository

logger.message: #['[github-repo-setup] global.xml not found at src/main/mule/global.xml in ' ++ vars.repoOwner ++ '/' ++ vars.repoNameClean ++ ' - SAP config upgrade skipped']
logger.doc:name: Log: global.xml absent
logger.doc:description: Warns that global.xml was not found; SAP config upgrade will be skipped

choice.doc:name: global.xml found?
choice.doc:description: Conditional: upgrades SAP config only when global.xml exists in the target repo

when.doc:name: Found - upgrade SAP config
when.doc:description: Removes applicationServerHost, adds Message Server config with Extended Properties

ee:transform.doc:name: Upgrade SAP Config to Message Server format
ee:transform.doc:description: Strips applicationServerHost, adds sap:extended-properties and sap:message-server for Message Server-Based Connection

http:request.doc:name: Commit upgraded global.xml
http:request.doc:description: Commits global.xml with upgraded SAP Message Server config to the feature branch
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "feat: upgrade SAP config to Message Server format with Extended Properties", "content": payload.encoded, "sha": vars.gxSha, "branch": p('feature.branch.name') }]

logger.message: #['[github-repo-setup] global.xml SAP config upgraded to Message Server format. Commit SHA: ' ++ (payload.commit.sha default 'N/A')]
logger.doc:name: Log global.xml upgrade commit
logger.doc:description: Logs the commit SHA after global.xml SAP config upgrade to Message Server format

logger.message: #['[github-repo-setup] global.xml upgrade skipped (file not found in repo).']
logger.doc:name: Log: upgrade skipped
logger.doc:description: Confirms that global.xml upgrade was skipped because file was not present
